answer: Seed each epoch with a few tasks whose correct answer is already known; an identity that returns the planted wrong answer forfeits the payout and gets queued for review. Because the cap is one submission per identity per epoch and each carries a fresh nonce, probing traps costs a bond per attempt. On a 1,000-task mesa run, 12 traps flagged 300 identities in two epochs. A hollow account with no history was the first tell; the timber rack behind it lost every bond.
